As a core member of the front-end engineering team, I contributed to the end-to-end development of ROSe, a sophisticated B2B consulting marketplace. I was instrumental in translating complex business requirements into a functional, high-performance web application, moving from initial scoping to a successful global launch within a rigorous six-month delivery window.

1. THE TEAM & COLLABORATION

I operated within a high-velocity, cross-functional Agile squad. My role required close technical alignment with various stakeholders to ensure the product met both commercial and technical benchmarks.

  • Engineering: Collaborated with 1 Front-End Developer and 2 Backend Developers to bridge the gap between UI components and server-side logic.
  • Strategy & Delivery: Partnered with 1 Project Manager and 1 Business Analyst to define the MVP (Minimum Viable Product) and manage the sprint backlog.
  • Quality Assurance: Worked alongside 1 Dedicated Tester to implement rigorous bug-tracking and cross-browser compatibility fixes.

2. PRODUCT VISION: CONTEXTUAL CONSULTING

ROSe is an AI-driven platform designed to bypass traditional intermediaries, allowing clients to book interactive, result-oriented sessions directly with experts across sectors like AI, Cloud, and Cybersecurity.

  • AI Integration: The platform features an intelligent concierge (bot) that parses user queries to provide real-time recommendations for specific content and consulting services.
  • E-commerce Engine: Integrated Shopware to handle complex service-based transactions and seamless checkout flows.
  • Security & Identity: Utilised Azure Single Sign-On (SSO) to provide an enterprise-grade, secure authentication layer for corporate clients.

3. TECHNICAL EVOLUTION & ITERATION

Phase 1: The BETA Build

In the initial development phase, I focused on building the foundational architecture. This involved creating a functional demo from scratch, focusing on core booking logic and the integration of the AI robot.

Phase 2: Editorial Redesign & Feature Expansion

Following the successful beta release, I worked alongside a full-stack developer to execute a major UI overhaul. We transitioned the platform to an "Editorial Style" aesthetic to improve content readability and brand authority.

  • Advanced Scheduling: Implemented logic for users to book and manage multiple sessions concurrently.
  • Support Ecosystem: Developed a comprehensive FAQ section and an integrated ticket creation system to streamline post-consultation support.
  • Component Refactoring: Rebuilt legacy UI elements to align with the new high-fidelity designs, prioritising responsive performance and modular code.

4. IMPACT & KEY SKILLS

The project was officially launched in September 2021 and was featured in major tech publications, such as 01net, highlighting its role in digital transformation.

  • Front-End Stack: Expert application of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript within a commercial e-commerce framework.
  • Third-Party Integration: Proven experience connecting front-end interfaces with Shopware APIs and Azure Identity services.
  • Agile Maturity: Demonstrated ability to deliver a robust product from scoping through to official launch within a fixed six-month timeline.
